fields.climate: desert; continental (large daily and seasonal temperature ranges)
fields.terrain: vast semidesert and desert plains, grassy steppe, mountains in west and southwest; Gobi Desert in south-central
fields.hazards: dust storms; grassland and forest fires; drought; "zud," which is harsh winter conditions
fields.resources: oil, coal, copper, molybdenum, tungsten, phosphates, tin, nickel, zinc, fluorspar, gold, silver, iron
fields.farm: milk, wheat, lamb/mutton, potatoes, beef, carrots/turnips, goat milk, goat meat, bison milk, horse meat
fields.exports: coal, copper ore, gold, iron ore, crude petroleum
fields.industries: construction and construction materials; mining (coal, copper, molybdenum, fluorspar, tin, tungsten, gold); oil; food and beverages…
fields.languages: Mongolian 90% (official, Khalkha dialect is predominant), Turkic, Russian
fields.religions: Buddhist 51.8%, no religion 40.6%, Muslim 3.2%, Shaman 2.5%, Christian 1.3%, Other 0.6%
fields.legal: civil law system influenced by Soviet and Romano-Germanic systems; constitution ambiguous on judicial review of legislative acts
fields.military: 18-25 years of age for voluntary service for men and women; initial service 24 months; compulsory service for men at 18…
